narrative: Today's top technology briefing highlights major strides in artificial intelligence, advancements in cybersecurity infrastructure, and significant news within the developer and scientific communities. From AI revolutionizing drug discovery to the deployment of post-quantum DNSSEC, the tech landscape is dynamic and rapidly evolving.

highlights.title: Dust and Water in Sagittarius A*
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope continues to unveil cosmic mysteries, providing new insights into the composition of celestial bodies like Sagittarius A*.

highlights.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
highlights.whyItMatters: AI tools like Codex and ChatGPT are revolutionizing drug discovery by accelerating the search for antimicrobial candidates against drug-resistant infections.

highlights.title: Google is making it easier to switch between password managers on Android
highlights.whyItMatters: This update enhances user control and security on Android by simplifying the transition between password management solutions, including passkeys.

highlights.title: Universal Music is launching an AI music platform with ElevenLabs
highlights.whyItMatters: Major music labels are adopting AI to empower users with tools for creating remixes and new music from licensed catalogs, showcasing AI's impact on creative industries.

highlights.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's implementation of post-quantum DNSSEC signifies a crucial step in preparing internet infrastructure against future quantum computing threats, bolstering security at scale.

highlights.title: Rust Is Tier-1 Language at Microsoft
highlights.whyItMatters: Microsoft's endorsement of Rust as a Tier-1 language underscores its growing importance in building secure and high-performance software systems within enterprise environments.

highlights.title: ID verification giant IDScan confirms data breach with more than 150 million driver’s licenses stolen
highlights.whyItMatters: A massive data breach at a prominent ID verification company highlights ongoing vulnerabilities in digital identity protection, impacting a vast number of individuals.

highlights.title: Cognition launches new SWE-2 model, Rivaling Fable 5.1 and GPT-Astra
highlights.whyItMatters: The introduction of new, powerful AI models like SWE-2 signifies continuous advancements in automated software engineering, potentially transforming development workflows.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.summary: AI continues its rapid expansion, enhancing scientific research, fostering creative industries, and making strides in automated software engineering with new model releases.

topics.name: Cybersecurity & Infrastructure
topics.summary: Advancements in internet security, including post-quantum DNSSEC, are critical as digital platforms face ongoing threats like significant data breaches.

topics.name: Developer & Platform News
topics.summary: The developer ecosystem sees shifts in core language adoption and platform enhancements aimed at improving user experience and system interoperability.

topics.name: Space & Scientific Exploration
topics.summary: New scientific discoveries from space telescopes reveal cosmic phenomena, while broader science news continues to explore fundamental questions and human endeavors beyond Earth.
